signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement from lane center.

nl_Literal_translation_en: From 2 to 10 seconds from now, the lane offset shall remain greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 2 秒到第 10 秒之间，车道横向偏移应始终大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the lane-keeping observation window from the second through the tenth second, the lateral offset magnitude shall remain strictly below 0.3 meters.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 2 秒至第 10 秒的车道保持观测窗口内，横向偏移绝对值应持续严格小于 0.3 米。
